items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: I was playing with him at an Army Camp and the record was playing and he said, gee, that's me!

ctx.x: But how do you feel when you hear yourself, well implicitly which is a matter of influence or explicitly which is sometimes a matter of fist....................(LAUGHTER).

It all depends on whether it's good or not. If it's good, okay. (LAUGHTER). If it's good you know. If it's not good it's a mess. You can't do anything about that. It's,you run into some big problems I think. Lester Young used to be so, they finally got so bad at it, he gave up his sound and style and everything because everybody else was doing it, right? It got to be so, I mean everybody playing every instrument was doing it. He influenced everybody really and especially those who play his tenor.

I remember one time we were, the juke box was playing right before we were ready to start playing. I was playing with him at an Army Camp and the record was playing and he said, gee, that's me! Oh, no that's not me.
